extractedSources.conditions: The Fallen Star is an item that randomly falls from the sky at night and disappears at dawn (4:30 AM). They can be used to craft Mana Crystals , which permanently increase a player's mana capacity by 20 points each. They are also used in a variety of crafting recipes, and as ammunition for the Star Cannon and Super Star Shooter . Hence, Fallen Stars can be stored in ammo slots .

In the uncommon event that a Fallen Star hits an enemy or critter , it will deal 1,000 base damage to the struck entity. [ 1 ] Fallen Stars cannot damage players, unless playing in a Remix or Zenith world. In these worlds, Fallen Stars that fall from the sky do not drop as an item on impact, and can only be obtained from pots or slimes as their bonus drop .

extractedSources.conditions: Treasure Bags are consumable grab bag -like items obtained in Expert Mode and Master Mode as a reward for defeating bosses . The contents and appearance of Treasure Bags depend on the boss it comes from, and are opened by using either ⚷ Open / Activate while inside the inventory , or ⚒ Use / Attack when selected in the hotbar . They emit light and have a special effect around them when dropped, making them easier to spot. In multiplayer , each player that deals damage to the boss receives one Treasure Bag upon defeating it. Treasure Bags are client-side and will despawn upon exiting the world. See Notes for details.

Treasure Bags are consumable grab bag -like items obtained in Expert Mode and Master Mode as a reward for defeating bosses . The contents and appearance of Treasure Bags depend on the boss it comes from, and are opened by using either ⚷ Open / Activate while inside the inventory , or ⚒ Use / Attack when selected in the hotbar . They emit light and have a special effect around them when dropped, making them easier to spot. In multiplayer , each player that deals damage to the boss receives one Treasure Bag upon defeating it. Treasure Bags are client-side and will despawn upon exiting the world. See Notes for details.

Treasure Bags are consumable grab bag -like items obtained in Expert Mode and Master Mode as a reward for defeating bosses . The contents and appearance of Treasure Bags depend on the boss it comes from, and are opened by using either ⚷ Open / Activate while inside the inventory , or ⚒ Use / Attack when selected in the hotbar . They emit light and have a special effect around them when dropped, making them easier to spot. In multiplayer , each player that deals damage to the boss receives one Treasure Bag upon defeating it. Treasure Bags are client-side and will despawn upon exiting the world. See Notes for details.

Treasure Bags are consumable grab bag -like items obtained in Expert Mode and Master Mode as a reward for defeating bosses . The contents and appearance of Treasure Bags depend on the boss it comes from, and are opened by using either ⚷ Open / Activate while inside the inventory , or ⚒ Use / Attack when selected in the hotbar . They emit light and have a special effect around them when dropped, making them easier to spot. In multiplayer , each player that deals damage to the boss receives one Treasure Bag upon defeating it. Treasure Bags are client-side and will despawn upon exiting the world. See Notes for details.
